newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan Dec leading index seen at 70.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan Dec leading index seen at 70.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators is expected to stay above the so-called boom or bust mark of 50 for a fourth consecutive month in December, with financial institutions forecasting a figure of 70.
A figure of above 50 -- out of a possible 100 -- is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months. The index was 77.8 in November.
The data is scheduled to be released on Friday.
The institutions expect a figure of 90 for the coincident index, which measures current economic conditions, compared with 100 in November.
"The strength (of the economy) is shown in the coincident index of the composite indices, which continues to show the pace of the recovery to be moderate," CS First Boston said in a statement.
The forecast of the leading index reflects positive readings for most areas, except for money supply, the Nikkei Commodity Index, and floor space of housing starts, First Boston said.
